intro: Rema Schneider is a human citizen who works out of the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind City. Situated along the quiet waterways between the major districts, she frequently assists local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries.

p: Tucked away in the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, positioned just west of the stone bridge leading across to Cathedral Square, Rema Schneider manages the daily needs of urban trade. Like many skilled artisans and assistants across the city, her work keeps cloth and finished garments moving between local craftsmen, relying on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.
